tier_compliance.reason: “They will pass on the dominant trait to their offspring” applies the concept to assert an outcome rather than making a Tier 2 connection.

visual_grounding.reason: “Both parents have the dominant allele M” specifically refers to the parental alleles shown around this Punnett square.

scientific_correctness.reason: “They will pass on the dominant trait to their offspring” misleadingly treats dominance as guaranteed inheritance; an Mm parent can transmit m, and the displayed cross includes mm offspring.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: The assertion that the offspring will inherit the dominant trait suggests all offspring have the condition, leading toward 4:0 instead of the gold 2:2.

answer_disclosure.reason: “They will pass on the dominant trait to their offspring” states an unconditional offspring outcome that makes the incorrect 4:0 choice immediate.
